Deleted after two minutes. I never really liked talkie, just didn’t enjoy it as much as I did c/j.ai, but I decided to come back to give it another try. I deleted it a couple minutes after and was met with possible hypocrisy.

Talkie advertises itself as having unlimited chats, but if you go to your profile (or at least when I went to mine), the first thing I saw was a pop-up saying you had to pay for unlimited chats.

Then the ads. Back when I first had Talkie, there were hardly, if any, ads at all. Within a minute I was hit with the same ad twice after exiting a chat. After which I deleted the app.

There is also no clear way on how to make a persona for chats. I don’t know if Talkie just doesn’t have persona’s, but if they do, I didn’t see a way to. The only thing I saw that you can create is a character, not a persona.

As I said, I didn’t like much anyways, but me and other people would appreciate if you changed it back.
